prose: Kotaku's report, carried by Techmeme, that hundreds of old games were decompiled and ported to run in browsers in recent weeks, driven by Claude Opus 5.5, with titles like GTA: Vice City and Halo: Combat Evolved running well.
Basis: the page was not fetched in this pass, so this rests on the headline and Techmeme's excerpt. The same story is covered in depth elsewhere in today's digest.
highlights: Hundreds of old games decompiled for the browser
GTA: Vice City and Halo: CE run well
